Old: each rank shows 'od {n} bodu' with n = level.minBookingOrder from loyalty_levels.min_booking_order (loyalty_ranks_screen.dart:452-455; loyalty_levels_provider.dart fromJson + fallback seed 1,3,5,...,39). v2 ignores that column and prints 2*level-2 (loyalty_ladder_v2.dart:140, tier headers :72-74, tier bar labels loyalty_status_parts_v2.dart:72-73). With the seed values the numbers differ by one on every rank (old rank 2 'od 3 bodu', v2 'od 2 bodu'; old rank 1 'od 1', v2 'od 0'). Server get_loyalty_status computes pct = LEAST(20, CEIL((cnt+1)/2)) (SUPABASE_BACKEND_STATE_3.md:229), i.e. level L from 2L-2 points, so v2 matches the server and the old look's label is likely off by one (min_booking_order means 'from the n-th booking', not points). I could not read live loyalty_levels values. Not a block on any action - purely an informational difference - but it is content that differs from the old look and the column edited in Velin no longer affects v2.
verdicts.fix_idea: Owner decision needed: either keep v2's server-correct 2L-2 and fix the old label/DB meaning, or for strict parity print level.minBookingOrder in loyalty_ladder_v2.dart:140 (and tier header :74). Do not change the old screen or the RPC.
